blockers.detail: signed exact Stage/Responsibility templates are unavailable
Recommendation and Confirmation exact refs are unavailable
ProductionStartRequest/Decision are DTO-only; no production start service/router consumes the combined gate and creates TaskRun
compiler creates PlanStep without capabilityRef even though canonical PlanStep supports it
required slots, gate refs, output schema, checkpoint retry and compensation policies live only inside risk.stageCompilation instead of an executable canonical contract
not-applicable stages remain ordinary PlanStep entries; PlanStep has no canonical applicability or skip predicate
CompileStageTemplateRequest lacks Recommendation Confirmation Brief Evidence Eval MergePolicy and Policy exact refs
compiler does not prove dependency output schema is compatible with downstream input schema
compiled steps do not freeze responsibility-slot to exact capability and assignee resolution receipts
compiler preserves caller template order and has no published normalized topological ordering or compiler-input hash contract
compiled Plan is not invalidated by later template responsibility capability policy provider or license revocation
productionStartGateRequired is true but productionStartGateRef remains null and no service closes it
generic TaskRun creation is available but W7 composition from approved compiled Plan plus fresh confirmation and impact gate is missing
no installed media template can produce an org-org/dev-project compiled Plan and queued TaskRun

targetBoundary.compile: pure deterministic materialization from frozen exact inputs into a draft canonical PlanRevision; it must not create or start TaskRun

targetBoundary.runtime: TaskRun StepRun Checkpoint and RunEvent remain AIP authorities; no Workshop StageRun table or BFF state machine
